03 / From the group chat to the ground

Three steps. Game on.

01 / CHOOSE

Pick your session.

Enter your name and mobile, then select a date and hourly times. Your duration, total and advance are calculated for you.

02 / INQUIRE

Message the arena.

Submit your inquiry, then send the prepared WhatsApp message. DCL checks availability and advance before confirming.

03 / PLAY

Bring your team.

Confirm with at least 50% advance, arrive for your slot, and settle the balance after your game.

Do you provide bats and balls?

Please bring your bats and tape balls. DCL provides the arena, wickets and lighting.

Is my slot booked when I select it here?

No. This is an inquiry. Your slot is confirmed by the arena team on WhatsApp after availability and advance payment are checked.

Can I book a session that crosses midnight?

Yes. Choose your From and To times, such as 11 PM to 2 AM. The booking date is the evening of your session; hours after midnight fall on the following calendar day. Sessions can end as late as 5 AM.

How much advance do I need to pay?

A minimum 50% advance is required. The remaining balance is collected at the end of play on the session day.
